name: contextrail
description: ContextRail: automatic session handoff for Claude Code.

plugins.name: contextrail
plugins.description: Saves a handoff before long Claude Code sessions lose quality, and loads it into the next session.

plugins.name: contextrail-continue
plugins.description: Optional companion to ContextRail: after it saves a handoff, asks whether to start a new session from it, and clears and continues on yes. Needs a Claude Code version with mods (early access).
